title: 2380. Time Needed to Rearrange a Binary String

examples.explanation: After one second, s becomes "1011010". After another second, s becomes "1101100". After the third second, s becomes "1110100". After the fourth second, s becomes "1111000". No occurrence of "01" exists any longer, and the process needed 4 seconds to complete, so we return 4.
No occurrence of "01" exists in s, and the processes needed 0 seconds to complete, so we return 0.
